prompts.q: set the data format to tab delimited and include latitude and longitude
select air temperature in fahrenheit and dew point in fahrenheit as the data
prompts.check: () => { const p = [...(document.querySelector("select[name=data]") || { selectedOptions: [] }).selectedOptions].map((o) => o.value); return p.includes("tmpf") && p.includes("dwpf") && !p.includes("all"); }

prompts.q: set the start date to march 5 2024 and the end date to march 10 2024
prompts.check: () => String((document.querySelector("select[name=year1]") || { value: "" }).value) === "2024" && String((document.querySelector("select[name=month1]") || { value: "" }).value) === "3" && String((document.querySelector("select[name=day1]") || { value: "" }).value) === "5" && String((document.querySelector("select[name=year2]") || { value: "" }).value) === "2024" && String((document.querySelector("select[name=month2]") || { value: "" }).value) === "3" && String((document.querySelector("select[name=day2]") || { value: "" }).value) === "10"

prompts.q: turn off specials and turn on madis hfmetar / 5 minute asos
filter the stations for ames, select it and add it to the selected stations
represent missing data as an empty string

prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/\b62\b/].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }

prompts.q: up to what time does this archive contain observations
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/2026-10-1\d[T ]\d\d:\d\d/].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }

prompts.q: what is the aggregate request limit when stations are selected
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/1,?000 station[- ]years/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }
